checks.conclusion: Scene logistics and incoming station goods are added; player trade promises are subtracted. Not warehouse-only inventory.
Private/package API requests CORE state replacement with Menu.make; no SCRIPT unload callback is established by this path.
Abstract disposal method is package-private, not a callback a normal mod subclass can implement.
